remarks: Welcome to this charming colonial located in the coveted neighborhood of Shippan. This beautiful residence boasts 3 bedrooms 2.5 baths in spacious 3500 sq foot living area, on .39 acres all leading to endless possibilities.    The main level is bright and airy with a wonderful room to room flow, featuring a huge eat in, updated cooks. kitchen with an equally oversized island .this kitchen is great for entertaining or have your guests step out to a lovely outdoor patio overlooking your private back yard. A large formal dining room, living room with fire place, office and family room complete the first floor.  Upstairs, the primary bedroom is a peaceful retreat with its own en-suite bathroom featuring a double vanity and heated floor with an additional two bedrooms and a full bathroom. The attic space can be used as a fourth bedroom or playroom. There is a beautiful pergola, perfect for entertaining family and friends, watching outdoor movies or just relaxing in your private back yard.. This home is close to the Stamford Yacht Club, Chelsea Piers, the Stamford Train Station, beaches and downtown Stamford.
